This is a day trip video to Port Dickson. We drove from KL to Port Dickson to enjoy its beaches, Teluk Kemang, Pantai Cermin, Pantai Cahaya Negeri, Bukit Batu Putih and Cape Rachado Lighthouse. We spend only a Ringgit per person for Bukit Batu Putih entrance, RM 10 horse riding per person and about RM 25 for lunch (excluding highway toll and fuel). Economical to enjoy short trip.

Text:
In this travel vlog, I will be staycation at Lexis Hibiscus Port Dickson in Negeri Sembilan for a 3 day 2 night trip (马来西亚森美兰大红花度假村), one of the best hotel in Malaysia and largest water chalet in the world, and it was an experience I won't soon forget. The resort’s location, just a one-hour drive from Kuala Lumpur  Malaysia, 30 minutes from Seremban & 1 hour from Melaka Malaysia, made it an ideal getaway without the hassle of extensive travel.

Lexis Hibiscus Port Dickson has many types of rooms, including the famous Executive Pool Villa, Panorama Pool Villa, and Sky Pool Villa. I checked into a Premium Pool Villa, and the first thing that caught my eye was the stunning view of the Straits of Malacca. The villa itself was luxurious, with a private swimming pool and steam room that allowed me to take a dip anytime I wanted while enjoying the serene seascape.

Lexis Hibiscus Port Dickson has plenty of activities and things to do. The outdoor swimming pool was expansive and beautifully maintained, perfect for both leisurely swims and energetic splashing with the kids. For those who enjoy keeping fit, the gym had state-of-the-art equipment, which I made good use of each morning.

For those family’s with kids, parents sure will love Outdoor Playground and Kidz World, a dedicated area with engaging activities and games that keep children entertained for hours. Meanwhile, I enjoyed rejuvenating treatments and a relaxing ambiance at Lex Spa, a true escape from daily life.

Exploring the resort on bicycles was a highlight for me. The paths were scenic, and it was a fun way to get around. For the adventurous, the ATV rides at the beach offered an adrenaline-pumping experience. The rugged terrain provided a thrilling ride that left us all exhilarated. We balanced this with some friendly competition at the table tennis tables and improved my aim at the archery range.

Water sports were another exciting aspect of my stay. The variety of activities available ensured there was never a dull moment, whether we were kayaking, jet ski, banana boat or just floating leisurely on the calm waters.

The food at Lexis Hibiscus Port Dickson was also exceptional. The resort features several restaurants offering a wide range of cuisines, from local Malaysian dishes to international favorites. Each meal was a delightful culinary experience.

Additionally, Lexis Hibiscus Port Dickson provides a free shuttle service to famous attractions in Port Dickson, following the route below:
{ Resort - Benns Chocolate Factory - PD Ostrich & Pets Show Farm - Sunggala Gateway - Army Museum PD }

Overall, my stay at Lexis Hibiscus Port Dickson was nothing short of perfect. The combination of luxury, activities, and breathtaking views made it a destination we’ll definitely return to.

I hope you enjoy this video. If you visit Kuala Lumpur and want to escape the city but don't know where to stay in Port Dickson, I highly recommend choosing Lexis Hibiscus Port Dickson for your trip to Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

Port Dickson's night market, or "pasar malam," is a vibrant culinary haven located in Negeri Sembilan, right by the seaside. As the sun sets, the market comes alive with colorful stalls showcasing a delightful array of Malaysian street food. From sizzling satay and crispy fried snacks to sweet treats like putu bamboo and refreshing coconut drinks, there's something for everyone. The atmosphere is filled with the enticing aromas of grilled seafood and spices, drawing in both locals and tourists. With the sound of waves nearby, it's the perfect spot to enjoy delicious food while soaking in the lively coastal ambiance.

波德申的夜市（“pasar malam”）是一个充满活力的美食天堂，位于海边，提供各种马来西亚街头美食。随着太阳落下，市场变得热闹，五彩缤纷的摊位展示着令人垂涎的美味佳肴。从滋滋作响的沙爹、酥脆的炸小吃，到像菠萝蜜和清爽的椰子饮料等甜品，应有尽有。市场弥漫着烤海鲜和香料的诱人香气，吸引着本地人和游客。伴随着海浪声，这里是享受美味食物、沉浸在生动的海滨氛围中的完美去处。
